htmlTemplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=310,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<style>
:root{
  --bg-deep:#080206;
  --bg-mid:#160510;
  --bg-card:rgba(38,8,24,0.65);
  --bg-glass:rgba(255,40,100,0.06);
  --primary:#ff1e62;
  --primary-light:#ff6b9d;
  --accent:#c084fc;
  --gold:#ffd700;
  --text-main:#ffeef5;
  --text-sub:#b8869c;
  --text-muted:#75485c;
  --border-light:rgba(255,100,150,0.18);
  --border-glow:rgba(255,30,98,0.45);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;user-select:none}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;background:transparent;color:var(--text-main);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:8px 0}

/* 手机外框容器 */
.dv{
  position:relative;width:292px;height:600px;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%,#380a22 0%,#180410 45%,#070104 100%);
  border-radius:38px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #4a0e2e,0 0 0 5px #12020a,0 15px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.75),0 0 35px rgba(255,25,95,0.22);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,130,175,0.22);
}
/* 顶部氛围极光 */
.dv::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:-50px;left:-30px;right:-30px;height:140px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,20,90,0.28) 0%,rgba(168,85,247,0.12) 50%,transparent 75%);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:0;filter:blur(12px);
}

/* 背景上浮粒子 */
.bg-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.bg-particle{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;animation:floatUp linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes floatUp{
  0%{transform:translateY(610px) translateX(0) scale(0.5);opacity:0}
  15%{opacity:0.85}
  85%{opacity:0.85}
  100%{transform:translateY(-20px) translateX(24px) scale(1.2);opacity:0}
}

/* 年龄验证门禁 */
.age-gate{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#290719 0%,#080105 85%);
  z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:24px;text-align:center;border-radius:38px;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  transition:opacity 0.35s ease,transform 0.35s ease;
}
.age-gate.hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:scale(1.05)}
.age-icon{
  width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,98,0.2),rgba(192,132,252,0.1));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,60,120,0.35);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:32px;margin-bottom:14px;
  box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(255,30,98,0.35),inset 0 0 15px rgba(255,30,98,0.15);
  animation:pulseGlow 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,30,98,0.35)}50%{transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 0 32px rgba(255,30,98,0.65)}}
.age-title{color:#ff477e;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,51,102,0.5);letter-spacing:2px}
.age-warn{color:#d8a4b8;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:18px;max-width:230px;background:rgba(255,25,90,0.06);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,130,0.15)}
.age-warn b{color:#ff5c8a;font-weight:700}
.age-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;width:100%;max-width:220px}
.age-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 0;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:1px;transition:all 0.2s}
.age-btn.yes{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}
.age-btn.yes:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.age-btn.no{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);color:#997788}
.age-sub{color:#664052;font-size:7.5px;margin-top:14px;letter-spacing:1px}

/* 主内容视图 */
.dv-content{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative;z-index:1}
.dv-content.show{display:flex;animation:fadeIn 0.35s ease}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* 灵动岛状态栏 */
.sb{height:28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 18px;font-size:9px;color:#ff9ebb;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px}
.sb .is{position:absolute;top:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:68px;height:18px;background:#000;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,130,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding-right:6px}
.sb .is::after{content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff1e62;box-shadow:0 0 6px #ff1e62;animation:blink 3s infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,90%,100%{opacity:1}95%{opacity:0.2}}
.sb-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:7.5px;color:#ff6b9d}

/* 顶部角色与控制台栏 */
.top{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(45,6,24,0.85),rgba(70,12,38,0.75),rgba(45,6,24,0.85));
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-light);
  flex-shrink:0;padding:7px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;position:relative;
}
.top-av{
  width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:11px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#9333ea);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,23,85,0.45);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
}
.top-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.top-nm{color:#fff0f6;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.top-sub{color:#ff7aa2;font-size:7.5px;margin-top:1px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.top-vip{
  font-size:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe066,#ff9500);
  color:#2b1700;padding:2.5px 7px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:0.5px;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,0.45);
}

/* 三维沉沦度状态条 */
.status-bar{
  padding:7px 12px;background:rgba(16,3,10,0.65);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,130,0.1);flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;
}
.status-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.status-lb{font-size:7.5px;color:#c98ca3;letter-spacing:0.5px;width:38px;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:600}
.status-prog{flex:1;height:6px;background:rgba(255,60,120,0.1);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}
.status-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:width .55s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.status-fill::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);animation:statusShine 2.2s infinite}
@keyframes statusShine{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.status-fill.lust{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff1755,#ff7597);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}
.status-fill.obey{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7e22ce,#c084fc);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(168,85,247,0.5)}
.status-fill.shame{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#db2777,#f472b6);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(236,72,153,0.5)}
.status-num{font-size:7.5px;color:#ffb3cc;font-weight:700;min-width:26px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* 搜索栏 */
.search{padding:6px 10px 4px;background:rgba(18,4,11,0.5);position:relative}
.search input{
  width:100%;padding:6px 24px 6px 11px;border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.18);
  background:rgba(255,30,85,0.07);color:#ffeef5;font-size:8.5px;
  outline:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all 0.2s;
}
.search input:focus{border-color:rgba(255,80,130,0.55);background:rgba(255,30,85,0.12);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,30,85,0.22)}
.search input::placeholder{color:#6e4255}
.search-clear{position:absolute;right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:9px;color:#885566;cursor:pointer;display:none;padding:2px}
.search-clear.show{display:block}

/* 分类胶囊导航 */
.nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px 8px 6px;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto;background:rgba(18,4,11,0.4);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08)}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav label{
  flex-shrink:0;padding:3.5px 9px;border-radius:12px;font-size:8px;color:#a87488;
  cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,30,85,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,130,0.1);
  white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s;font-weight:600;
}
.nav label:active{transform:scale(0.94)}
.nav label.on{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1e62,#d91b5c);
  color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,150,180,0.4);
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(255,30,98,0.4);
}

/* 页面滑动容器 */
.pgs{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.pg{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:absolute;inset:0}
.pg.on{display:flex;animation:pgFade 0.22s ease}
@keyframes pgFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(3px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.scr{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:8px 10px 14px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar{width:2.5px}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,80,130,0.35);border-radius:2px}

/* 首页 - 等级黑金卡 */
.level-card{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(70,12,38,0.75) 0%,rgba(30,5,18,0.85) 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.32);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;
  margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}
.level-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-20px;right:-20px;width:90px;height:90px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,215,0,.22),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.level-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:7px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-badge{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe066,#ff8c00);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,200,0,.55);border:1.5px solid #fff3b0;
}
.level-info{flex:1}
.level-tt{color:#fff0f5;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.5px}
.level-st{color:#c48b9f;font-size:7.5px;margin-top:1px}
.level-cp{font-size:8.5px;color:#ffd700;font-weight:800;background:rgba(255,215,0,0.12);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.25)}
.level-prog{height:5px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.4);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-prog-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ff4d79);transition:width .5s ease;border-radius:3px}

/* 签到 / 推荐 / 抽卡 三连排 */
.action-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:9px}
.action-card{
  padding:9px 4px;border-radius:12px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,100,150,0.18);transition:all .18s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
}
.action-card:active{transform:scale(0.94)}
.action-card.signin{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,180,0,0.16),rgba(60,15,25,0.5))}
.action-card.signin.done{opacity:0.65;border-color:rgba(100,220,130,0.25)}
.action-card.recommend{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,30,98,0.2),rgba(60,10,30,0.5))}
.action-card.draw{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(168,85,247,0.22),rgba(45,10,60,0.5))}
.action-ic{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:3px;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))}
.action-tt{color:#ffeef5;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700}
.action-st{color:#b88296;font-size:6.5px;margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 3px}

/* 今日推荐横幅 */
.recommend-card{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,95,0.18),rgba(55,8,28,0.75));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.35);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 11px;
  margin-bottom:9px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(255,20,80,0.15);
  transition:transform 0.18s;
}
.recommend-card:active{transform:scale(0.97)}
.recommend-tag{
  position:absolute;top:7px;right:8px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff6b9d);color:#fff;
  font-size:6.5px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.8px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,23,85,.45);
}
.recommend-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.recommend-ic{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0;width:36px;height:36px;background:rgba(255,30,90,0.12);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,150,0.2)}
.recommend-info{flex:1;min-width:0;padding-right:32px}
.recommend-nm{color:#fff0f6;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.recommend-ds{color:#c48b9f;font-size:7.5px;line-height:1.35;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* 场景选择器 */
.scene-wrap{margin-bottom:9px}
.scene-list{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px}
.scene-list::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.scene-item{
  flex-shrink:0;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,30,85,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.16);
  font-size:8px;color:#b88296;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3.5px;
  font-weight:600;transition:all 0.18s;
}
.scene-item:active{transform:scale(0.94)}
.scene-item.on{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,180,200,0.5);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(255,30,85,0.4);
}

/* 栏目标题 */
.section-tt{
  color:#ffb3cc;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;
  margin:6px 2px 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
}
.section-tt-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.section-tt-left::before{content:'';width:3px;height:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff1755,#ff6b9d);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 0 6px #ff1755}
.section-tt-sub{font-size:7px;color:#885566;font-weight:500}

/* 分类网格 */
.cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px}
.cat-cd{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,35,95,0.08),rgba(40,6,20,0.45));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.14);border-radius:11px;padding:8px 4px;
  cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .18s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cat-cd:active{transform:scale(0.94);border-color:rgba(255,90,140,0.45);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,30,85,0.3)}
.cat-ic{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:3px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.3))}
.cat-nm{color:#ffeef5;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700}
.cat-cnt{color:#8c586c;font-size:6.5px;margin-top:1px}

/* 玩法列表卡片 */
.cd{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(48,8,26,0.75),rgba(24,4,14,0.85));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.14);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:6px;
  overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;position:relative;
}
.cd.rare-SSR{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,0.38);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(255,200,0,0.12)}
.cd.rare-SR{border-color:rgba(192,132,252,0.32)}
.cd:active{background:rgba(65,12,35,0.85)}
.cd-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 9px 7px}
.cd-ic{
  font-size:16px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,30,90,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.15);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
}
.cd-inf{flex:1;min-width:0;padding-right:28px}
.cd-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-nm{color:#fff0f6;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800}
.cd-lvl{font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:-1px}
.cd-ds{color:#b07a8e;font-size:7.5px;margin-top:2px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cd-tg{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-tg span{font-size:6px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,30,90,0.1);color:#cc88a0;border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.12)}
.cd-rare{position:absolute;top:7px;right:8px;font-size:6.5px;padding:1.5px 5.5px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.8px}

/* 卡片展开详情区 */
.cd-bd{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);border-top:1px solid transparent}
.cd-bd.on{grid-template-rows:1fr;border-top-color:rgba(255,90,140,0.12);background:rgba(12,2,7,0.45)}
.cd-bd-inner{overflow:hidden}
.cd-bd-content{padding:7px 9px 8px}
.cd-tx{
  color:#ffe6f0;font-size:7.5px;line-height:1.55;padding:6px 8px;
  background:rgba(255,30,90,0.05);border-radius:6px;
  border-left:2.5px solid #ff2a70;margin-bottom:5px;max-height:85px;overflow-y:auto;
}
.cd-tx b{color:#ff85ad}
.cd-bts{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:5px}
.cd-btn{
  flex:1;min-width:44%;padding:5.5px 4px;border-radius:7px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.22);background:rgba(255,30,90,0.09);
  color:#ffb3cc;font-size:7.5px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;
  text-align:center;font-weight:700;transition:all .15s;
}
.cd-btn:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.cd-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border:none;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,23,85,0.35)}
.cd-btn.dn{background:rgba(34,197,94,0.22)!important;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.4)!important;color:#86efac!important;box-shadow:none!important}

/* 强度选择器 */
.variant-wrap{margin:2px 0 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
.variant-tt{color:#b88296;font-size:7px;font-weight:600}
.variant-opts{display:flex;gap:4px}
.variant-opt{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,30,90,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.15);color:#b07a8e;font-size:6.5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;transition:all 0.15s}
.variant-opt.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,23,85,0.4)}

/* 工具页 */
.tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.tool-cd{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,30,90,0.1),rgba(40,6,22,0.55));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,90,140,0.2);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 8px;
  cursor:pointer;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:all 0.18s;
}
.tool-cd:active{transform:scale(0.95);border-color:rgba(255,90,140,0.5)}
.tool-ic{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px;position:relative;z-index:1}

// 多通道指令发送与剪贴板回退（兼容iframe沙盒与各类宿主前端）
function sendToHost(text,toastMsg){
  try{
    parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:text},'*');
    parent.postMessage({type:'send-message',text:text},'*');
  }catch(e){}
  var copied=false;
  try{
    if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(function(){fallbackCopy(text)});
      copied=true;
    }else{
      copied=fallbackCopy(text);
    }
  }catch(e){copied=fallbackCopy(text)}
  showToast(toastMsg||(copied?'📤 已填入输入框并复制':'📤 指令已发送'));
}

function fallbackCopy(text){
  try{
    var ta=document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value=text;
    ta.style.position='fixed';ta.style.left='-9999px';ta.style.top='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.focus();ta.select();
    var ok=document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    return ok;
  }catch(e){return false}
}

function spawnFx(emoji,x,y){
  var dv=$('dvRoot');
  var rect=dv.getBoundingClientRect();
  var cx=(x?x-rect.left:rect.width/2);
  var cy=(y?y-rect.top:rect.height/2);
  for(var i=0;i<6;i++){
    var p=document.createElement('div');
    p.className='fx-particle';
    p.textContent=emoji;
    p.style.left=(cx+rnum(-30,30))+'px';
    p.style.top=(cy+rnum(-15,15))+'px';
    p.style.animationDelay=(i*0.06)+'s';
    dv.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(function(el){if(el&&el.parentNode)el.parentNode.removeChild(el)},1200,p);
  }
}

function triggerDrawCard(){

function bindListEvents(){
  var s=$('listScr');
  s.querySelectorAll('.cd').forEach(function(cd){

      var btn=e.target.closest('.cd-btn');
      var varOpt=e.target.closest('.variant-opt');
      if(varOpt){
        e.stopPropagation();
        cd.querySelectorAll('.variant-opt').forEach(function(v){v.classList.remove('on')});
        varOpt.classList.add('on');
        vibrate(15);
        return;
      }
      if(btn){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var t=btn.dataset.t;
        var name=cd.dataset.name;
        var catId=cd.dataset.cat;
        var entry=findPlayItem(catId,name);
        if(!entry)return;
        var itm=entry.item;
        if(t==='fav'){
          toggleFav(name);

            showToast(isFav(name)?'💛 已加入收藏夹':'已取消收藏');
          }
          vibrate(20);return;
        }
        if(t==='detail'){
          curDetail=itm;showPage('detail');renderDetail(entry.cat,itm);return;
        }
        if(t==='c'||t==='u'){
          var activeVarEl=cd.querySelector('.variant-opt.on');
          var variantName=activeVarEl?activeVarEl.dataset.vname:'';
          var full=buildSendText(itm,t,variantName);

      if(bd)bd.classList.toggle('on');
    };
  });

    this.textContent='继续挑战';

    this.textContent='暂停计时';

  }
};
